# Make My Lesson

> Make My Lesson is an AI lesson-planning platform for teachers. It helps create curriculum-aligned lesson plans, slide decks, classroom activities, and assessments. This file lists important public pages only (no login, signup, or in-app dashboard URLs).

Canonical public site: https://www.makemylesson.ai
Contact: hello@makemylesson.ai

## Product

- [Home](https://www.makemylesson.ai/): Product overview and how Make My Lesson works
- [Pricing](https://www.makemylesson.ai/pricing): Plans, pricing, and school quotes
- [FAQs](https://www.makemylesson.ai/faq): Common questions about the product
- [Contact](https://www.makemylesson.ai/contact): Contact and support
- [Blog](https://www.makemylesson.ai/blog): Teaching guides and product updates

## Features

- [AI Lesson Plan Generator](https://www.makemylesson.ai/features/lesson-plan-generator): Curriculum-aligned lesson plans
- [AI Presentation Maker](https://www.makemylesson.ai/features/presentation-maker): Classroom-ready slide decks
- [AI Classroom Activities](https://www.makemylesson.ai/features/classroom-activities): Engaging classroom activities
- [AI Test Generator](https://www.makemylesson.ai/features/test-generator): Quizzes and assessments

## Teaching Methods

- [Teaching Methods](https://www.makemylesson.ai/teaching-methods): Hub of supported teaching approaches
- [General (Teacher-Led)](https://www.makemylesson.ai/teaching-methods/general-teacher-led): Direct, structured instruction
- [Flipped Classroom](https://www.makemylesson.ai/teaching-methods/flipped-classroom): Pre-class instruction, in-class practice
- [Blended Learning](https://www.makemylesson.ai/teaching-methods/blended-learning): Face-to-face plus online learning
- [Spaced Learning](https://www.makemylesson.ai/teaching-methods/spaced-learning): Retrieval practice over time
- [Inquiry-Based Learning](https://www.makemylesson.ai/teaching-methods/inquiry-based-learning): Student questions drive investigation
- [Project-Based Learning](https://www.makemylesson.ai/teaching-methods/project-based-learning): Extended real-world projects
- [Problem-Based Learning](https://www.makemylesson.ai/teaching-methods/problem-based-learning): Learning through complex problems
- [Service Learning](https://www.makemylesson.ai/teaching-methods/service-learning): Curriculum linked to community service
- [Collaborative Learning](https://www.makemylesson.ai/teaching-methods/collaborative-learning): Structured group work
- [Gamification](https://www.makemylesson.ai/teaching-methods/gamification): Points, levels, and challenges
- [Kinesthetic Learning](https://www.makemylesson.ai/teaching-methods/kinesthetic-learning): Movement and hands-on tasks
- [Crossover Learning](https://www.makemylesson.ai/teaching-methods/crossover-learning): Classroom plus informal learning
- [Personalised Learning](https://www.makemylesson.ai/teaching-methods/personalised-learning): Pace and support tailored to students
- [Competency-Based Learning](https://www.makemylesson.ai/teaching-methods/competency-based-learning): Progress by demonstrated mastery
- [Experiential Learning](https://www.makemylesson.ai/teaching-methods/experiential-learning): Learn by doing with reflection
- [Mindfulness & SEL](https://www.makemylesson.ai/teaching-methods/mindfulness-sel): Social-emotional learning strategies
